Theme
DLX HAULER MANUAL

2052. Society's a smoking crater. The Dumplord's still pushing crap and people still want it. You're a DLX rookie. Tap to thrust. Don't crash. Get paid.

The Rigs (swap in the Garage)

Three starters free out of the gate. Five more in the Garage — most carry a perk that changes how they fly.

  • SCOUT — small & agile · ×1.00 · free
  • HAULER — balanced · ×1.25 · free
  • FREIGHTER — big & heavy · passive tractor beam · ×1.60 · free
  • WARDEN — chrome paint · ×1.25 · cosmetic only · 800 🔩
  • SPARK — cyan racer · ×1.10 · Magnet Range +50% · 1500 🔩
  • ANVIL — armored heavy · ×1.30 · Heat Shield (1 lava hit) · 2500 🔩
  • GHOST — wraith · ×1.15 · Lift Assist (gravity ×0.85) · 3500 🔩
  • VOLT — late-game endurance · ×1.40 · Long Battery (fuel cell 9s) · 5000 🔩

The Sunset Loop

  1. Sunset Wastes — 0 … 49
  2. Rust City — 50 … 109
  3. Cinder Belt — 110 … 179 (lava balls)
  4. Tentacle Trench — 180 … 239 (OL' SLITHER)
  5. Scrap City — 240 … 299 (THE LANDLORD)
  6. Bandit Canyon — 300 … 389 (RAZORHANK ambush)
  7. Toxic Fen — 390 … 469 (BARRELHEAD)
  8. Frostfall Pass — 470 + (NIGHT SHIFT — the cops)

Mid-flight mods

  • Bumper — eats a hit (stacks to 3)
  • Time Warp — pipes at ½ speed · 5s
  • ×2 Payday — score ×2 · 6s
  • Tractor Beam — pulls loose loot · 6s
  • Phase Shift — slip through pipes · 3s
  • Road Kill — auto-launches on pickup · homes to the next pillar, opponent, or tentacle

Payouts

  • Clear a pillar: +1 · grab loose loot: +1
  • Sealed DLX cargo crates (gold): +5
  • Opponent hits: +5 – +8 · downs: +20 – +40
  • Chain pickups for ×2 / ×3 / ×4 combo bonus

Unlocks

  • 🔥 ROAD-KLL — survive the cops at Frostfall Pass once and you've earned a polished chrome rig with candy-red glass, twin smokestacks, blue nitrous, and a sweeping red scanner across the roof. Equipped from the Garage. While active: launches with a bumper and double-flap kicks a boost.

The Daily Drop

Every day, every player runs the same seeded delivery course — same wreckage, same cargo thieves, same lava balls. Unlimited attempts, best score saves. Haul cargo from the DLX dispatch center to the GOOD BUDDY TRUCK STOP.

  • Arrive with cargo intact: +300 🔩
  • Arrive without it: +50 🔩
  • Crash before arrival: 0 🔩

Streaks (play every day, stack the bonus)

Show up tomorrow to start a streak. Skip a day, it resets to 0. Bonus stacks on every Daily Drop:

  • 3 days: +50 🔩
  • 7 days: +100 🔩
  • 14 days: +200 🔩
  • 30 days: +400 🔩

Daily seed rolls over at your local midnight. The DAILY button shows ⏰ HH:MM until the next puzzle drops.
